hero.title: We get your goods across the border.
hero.subtitle: Trained handling crews, forklifts and lifting equipment stationed at Jordan's main crossings, with the truck and customs paperwork handled alongside.

highlights.title: The border stops being the slow part.

coverage.title: Five crossings, one operator
coverage.body: Jaber, Tarbil, Al-Karamah, Al-Omari and Al-Mudawwara. The same crew standards, the same equipment and the same single point of contact at every one.

equipment.title: Equipment already on site
equipment.body: Forklifts in multiple capacities plus winches and lifting gear kept at the crossing, so your cargo moves instead of waiting on a machine to arrive.

crews.title: Crews who have done it before
crews.body: Experienced teams handling palletised, bagged, drummed, bulk and oversized cargo quickly and without damage.

paperwork.title: Paperwork moving in parallel
paperwork.body: Truck and customs documentation prepared and followed through while the cargo is handled, so nothing waits on a signature.

services.title: Border logistics services
services.subtitle: Four services that together get a loaded truck from one side of a crossing to the other.

crossBorder.title: Cross-border cargo handling
crossBorder.short: Your goods, moved across the crossing.
crossBorder.body: Handling crews and equipment stationed at the crossing to move your cargo across quickly and get it back on the road on the far side.

lifting.title: Lifting & heavy handling
lifting.short: Winches, cranes and heavy lifting gear.
lifting.body: Winches and lifting equipment for heavy, awkward and out-of-gauge pieces that a standard forklift cannot safely take.

clearance.title: Documentation & clearance support
clearance.short: The paperwork, prepared and followed through.
clearance.body: Preparation and follow-through of truck and customs documentation so your shipment clears without avoidable delay.

coordination.title: Truck coordination
coordination.short: Both sides of the crossing, arranged.
coordination.body: Arranging and sequencing the trucks on each side so arrival, handling and departure line up instead of queuing.

crossings.title: Jordan's border crossings
crossings.subtitle: We are present at all five of the crossings that matter for regional freight.

jaber.name: Jaber
jaber.short: The northern gateway, on the Amman–Damascus corridor.
jaber.body: Our crews and forklifts at Jaber handle northbound and southbound cargo on the main Syria–Jordan corridor, with documentation support running alongside.

tarbil.name: Tarbil
tarbil.short: The eastern desert route into Iraq.
tarbil.body: Handling and lifting capability on the long desert route east, where equipment on station is the difference between a same-day turnaround and an overnight wait.

alKaramah.name: Al-Karamah
alKaramah.body: Cross-border cargo handling and truck coordination at the busiest Jordan–Iraq freight point, with crews sized to the volume.

alOmari.name: Al-Omari
alOmari.short: The southern gateway to the Gulf.
alOmari.body: The crossing most of our Saudi-bound and Saudi-origin freight passes through, with forklifts and lifting gear kept permanently on site.

alMudawwara.name: Al-Mudawwara
alMudawwara.short: The far southern crossing into Saudi Arabia.
alMudawwara.body: Jordan’s southernmost gateway, on the desert route below Ma’an. It carries the traffic that would otherwise run the length of the country to reach Al-Omari, and it is the shorter road for anything moving between the south of Jordan and the Saudi interior.

cta.title: Goods waiting at a border?
cta.subtitle: Tell us the crossing and what is on the truck. We will tell you what it takes to get it moving.

equipment.title: Machines waiting at the crossing, not on their way to it.
equipment.subtitle: Forklifts, cranes and lifting gear kept on station, with the crews to operate them.
equipment.intro: The slowest part of a border move is usually waiting for a machine to arrive. We keep ours at the crossings, in a range of capacities, so a shipment is handled when it turns up rather than when equipment becomes free.

forklifts.title: Forklifts in multiple capacities
forklifts.body: From light units for palletised goods up to heavy-capacity machines for dense industrial loads, so nothing is handled by a machine that is straining at it.

cranes.title: Mobile and gantry cranes
cranes.body: For pieces beyond forklift reach or weight: machinery, structural sections and anything that has to come off the top rather than the side.

winches.title: Winches and recovery gear
winches.body: For shifted loads, awkward positioning and cargo that needs to be drawn rather than lifted.

attachments.title: Attachments and handling gear
attachments.body: Slings, spreaders, clamps and drum handlers, so bagged, drummed and irregular cargo is picked up the way it is designed to be picked up.

crews.title: Certified operators
crews.body: The equipment comes with people who use it every day. Damage at a border is expensive to argue about and slow to resolve.

maintenance.title: Maintained in-house
maintenance.body: Our own workshop services the fleet on a schedule, because a forklift out of action at a crossing stops more than one shipment.

seo.title: Forklifts, Cranes & Lifting Equipment
seo.description: Forklifts in multiple capacities, mobile and gantry cranes, winches and handling gear stationed at Jordan's border crossings with certified operators.

customs.title: The paperwork moves while the cargo does.
customs.subtitle: Truck and customs documentation prepared, submitted and followed through.
customs.intro: A shipment sitting complete but unsigned is still a shipment that has not arrived. We run the documentation alongside the physical handling so the two finish together, and we tell you where things stand rather than waiting to be asked.

intake.title: Intake and checks
intake.body: We take the consignment details up front and check the paperwork is complete before the truck is anywhere near the crossing.

documents.title: Document preparation
documents.body: Manifests, permits and supporting documents prepared to what the crossing actually expects, which is not always what the guidance says.

submission.title: Submission and follow-through
submission.body: Filed with the relevant authorities and chased. Someone whose job is your file, rather than a queue number.

coordination.title: Truck coordination
coordination.body: Arrival, handling and departure sequenced on both sides so the trucks are not waiting on each other.

release.title: Release and onward dispatch
release.body: Cleared cargo handed to the onward carrier, often our own transport company, with the documentation that travels with it.

updates.title: Status you do not have to chase
updates.body: A named contact who calls when something changes, including when it changes for the worse.

seo.title: Customs Documentation & Clearance Support
seo.description: Truck and customs documentation prepared, submitted and followed through at the Jaber, Tarbil, Al-Karamah, Al-Omari and Al-Mudawwara crossings in Jordan.

home.title: Border Cargo Handling & Clearance in Jordan
home.description: Abu Sonbul For Logistic Services moves goods across the Jaber, Tarbil, Al-Karamah, Al-Omari and Al-Mudawwara crossings with forklifts, lifting equipment, trained crews and documentation support.

intro.title: About the company
intro.body: Abu Sonbul for Logistic Services gets goods through Jordan’s border crossings. Trained handling crews, forklifts and lifting equipment are stationed at Jaber, Tarbil, Al-Karamah and Al-Omari, with the customs paperwork prepared alongside so nothing waits on a signature.
